title: Job Lock: 24% of US Employees Stuck in Unwanted Jobs for Health Insurance
discussion_signal: The post translates job lock into a mobility and opportunity problem: health coverage can make changing jobs, entrepreneurship, or leaving a poor fit materially risky. Replies add chronic-condition, medical-debt, gender, and personal-cost perspectives, showing how insurance attachment becomes a practical constraint on agency.
linked_research_question: How do workers and benefits professionals interpret employer-linked health coverage as a constraint on mobility, entrepreneurship, and everyday choice?
limits: Single organizational post with selected replies
Self-reports and interpretations are not a representative workforce sample
The post does not establish causal effects on entrepreneurship or wage growth
Public search discovery is not a platform-native Creator/API export
